info.title: ReverseNX-RT
info.author: masagrator, ppkantorski
info.description: Switch between handheld and docked modes in real time.
info.details:
ReverseNX-RT is an Ultrahand overlay that lets you switch compatible games between handheld and docked rendering modes in real time.

Useful for forcing a game's handheld or docked graphics profile without rebooting the console or restarting the game, allowing you to compare image quality, resolution, performance, and power behavior on the fly.
